perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.desc: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Dark Ether Reaper
perks.desc:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Holy cow did I not see this coming. A sniper that doesn't only have perks mixed in different slots, but a sniper that can apply Weaken. Explosive Payload will give you a slight damage bump and apply Weaken with Withering Gaze. This sniper doesn't really fit the conventional deal of great DPS or single target damage, nor does it “add clear” like other weapons could. It's almost like Bungie took the normal sniper perks, put them into a jar and shook them up." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Sovereignty has even worse perks for PvP. No Moving Target, no Snapshot Sights, no Opening Shot, no Surplus, no Slickdraw or Quickdraw. Nothing. It does have Withering Gaze to apply Weaken which in the crucible would be extremely strong. But really, nothing to supplement it outside of a splash with Explosive Payload." Recommended MW: Handling.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 119 from 22 October 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6CEZXurwhqejVZpX506M2a?si=7ef44c5f06ae4412) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways, and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-MajorSpec PvE-BossSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice utility PvE pick for weakening Major and Boss enemies in both general and end-game, underleveled content, particularly with void builds. Sovereignty is a void adaptive Sniper Rifle with overall in-band stats so, unfortunately it's not as good as a rapid-fire as a backup boss damage weapon. At base, it has 45 Zoom, 40 Handling which equates to 0.39s ready, 0.41s ADS speed and 0.34s stow speed, while the Reload Speed of 39 is a 3.04s reload. Total ammo at base with 0, 1, 2 and 3 reserve mods is 21/23/25/26. You might find a little help with the recoil direction useful or, if you can handle it, look for some extra handling or stability. In the magazine perk slot, look to increase magazine size - Appended or Extended Mag with a Backup Mag mod takes total ammo to 25/27/29/30. Combined with the origin trait, you can potentially get 10 in an overflowed mag (13 when the weapon's enhanced). In the second trait perk column is the new-to-season-25 Withering Gaze, which can apply void Weaken global debuff from a safe distance after ADSing for 1.5s (to possibly pair with Echoes of Harvest and Starvation?), for a ×1.15 damage boost while active. There's nothing much that synergises in the first column, so Explosive Payload is tried and trusted for a bit of extra damage, and some flinch. The Dark Ether origin trait is one of the best in the sandbox for PvE - generate a Dark Ether charge for 5s from kills, and then shoot with any weapon (or run into) the charge to proc a Dragonfly-type detonation which also overflows your weapon to ×1.4 (rounded up) base capacity or ×1.8 when enhanced, completely bypassing reload. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod, or possibly an Anti-Flinch or Synergy (to proc Echo of Starvation) mod when enhanced.
